Name: So Many Horses for Adopt'n'Skin
Author: ivycrowned
Description:
This horse skin pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt'n'Skin[/url] is a compliment to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5178]BFAV So Many Horses[/url].

The horses are all textured with real horse colors, patterns, and markings in a variety of combinations, totaling 50 unique horses.
Saddles have also been redrawn. Each horse is available with a black saddle, brown saddle, or no saddle.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1][*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt'n'Skin[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and unzip the horse pack of your choice (Black Saddle, Brown Saddle, No Saddle) or the Mega Pack that combines all three.
[*]Rename and place the files you want in the [font=Courier New][size=2]/assets/skins[/size][/font] folder of Adopt'n'Skin. All horse files should be named [font=Courier New][size=2]Horse_[Skin ID][/size][/font], with the [font=Courier New][size=2][Skin ID][/size][/font] being a unique number over 1.
[*]Additional Adopt'n'Skin instructions can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]here[/url]﻿.
[/list]
